subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should cron jobs inherit a configured default recipient, and should that inheritance apply only when a job is created or dynamically on every run?
rationale: This choice changes recipient-routing semantics, inspectability, security posture, and upgrade behavior; repository source cannot establish the intended product contract.

options.title: Creation-time default
options.body: Copy the configured default into new jobs so every persisted job has a stable, inspectable recipient while existing jobs remain unchanged.

options.title: Run-time default
options.body: Resolve omitted delivery against current configuration on every run, enabling centralized changes but silently retargeting existing jobs.

options.title: Keep recipients explicit
options.body: Do not add recipient inheritance; instead improve warnings and setup surfaces so users must confirm each job destination.

recommendation.title: Creation-time default
recommendation.body: Copy the configured default into new jobs so every persisted job has a stable, inspectable recipient while existing jobs remain unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current create-time resolver and have the strongest recent history across the cron and config decision surfaces.
